column1: # Lamakan confrontation: Ash Jenna's origin, her offer, and Isaac's response.

column3: You came back.\nI knew you wouldn't\nleave a mystery alone.{end_wait}
I saw you before.\nYou look like Jenna.\nTell me who you are.{end_wait}
You kept going,\njust as I thought.\nGood, Isaac.{end_wait}
I know Jenna.\nYou have her face.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I'm Jenna. Not yours.
The beacons in my world
were all lit.{page_break}Then our home was gone.
The Wise One did nothing.
I was there to see it.{end_wait}
Why come to Isaac?\nWhat can he do\nthat you couldn't?{end_wait}

He gave you a task.
You can reach him.
That makes you useful.{page_break}I'll make him answer
for what happened.
Help me, or stand aside.{end_wait}
She wants Isaac to\nbring her closer to him.\nWe can't trust her.{end_wait}
She may believe it.\nBut look what she's\nasking Isaac to do.{end_wait}
You risked your life\nfor those miners.\nHow very generous.{end_wait}
Help her confront\nthe Wise One?{end_now}
I'll help find the truth.\nBut I won't hurt\nanyone for you.{end_wait}
We'll see how long\nyou hold to that\nwhen the time comes.{end_wait}
Isaac, be careful.\nShe has Jenna's face,\nnot Jenna's heart.{end_wait}
Remember my face,\nIsaac. You'll need it\nwhen the time comes.{end_wait}
No. I won't help\nyou hunt someone\non your word alone.{end_wait}
Refuse all you like.\nYou'll still have to\nlive with what comes.{end_wait}
We need to go.\nJenna's still with them.{end_wait}
Don't let her put\nher anger in your\nhands, Isaac.{end_wait}

Your Jenna and Kraden
are still with Menardi.
Felix travels with them.{page_break}The road goes to Kalay.
I'd hurry if I were you.
We'll meet again.{end_wait}
